replication.target_description: Warning versus Basic contrast in mean participant-level AMP effects (positive-prime minus negative-prime pleasant-response proportions); HC1-robust regression with Basic, Warning and pooled Incentive conditions. Same replication contrast applies to both original studies.

n.sample_role: Participants in the fitted three-condition regression; contrast compares 182 Basic and 189 Warn participants, with 773 Incentive participants also in the model.
n.exclusions: Fewer than 10 completed trials; trials with reaction time above 5 s (4% of trials and 15 participants); same response on all targets (5%); able to read or write Chinese (5%).
n.location: Sample size and rejection criteria, paragraph ending in condition-specific final sample counts (before Results; cached parse has no page breaks).
n.quote: This left 1144 subjects in analyses below: 182 in Basic, 189 in Warn, and 773 in the Incentive conditions
